instruction: A candid outdoor full shot captures a sunny grassy park with tall trees in the background. On the left, the Black woman in a red t-shirt (R5) leans forward in a deep squat, pulling a yellow rope with her face obscured. Behind her on the right, the East Asian man in a red polo shirt (R3) crouches low, pulling the rope with a wide, joyful smile. They are playing a competitive game of tug-of-war together, holding onto the rope with both hands. The scene is illuminated by bright, natural daylight, casting soft shadows on the green grass.

R3 crouches low behind R5 while pulling the same rope
